page_title: NAN 1-1 MAR | Nantes v Marseille 01/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Ruddy Buquet is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar.
90+5' 8:23 – the total goal attempt statistics.

90+4' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the left post. His promising effort is kept out by Remy Descamps, who pulls off a stunning save!
90+1' Moses Simon goes off the pitch and Marquinhos (Nantes) comes on.
90+1' Renan Lodi (Marseille) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.

90' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball is out of play and Marseille manage to earn a corner.
90' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
89' The ball is cleared after Vitinha (Marseille) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
88' It's time for a substitution. Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) comes on in place of Pedro Chirivella.
87' Chancel Mbemba (Marseille) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
86' Valentin Rongier (Marseille) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Remy Descamps has it covered and makes a comfortable save.

84' Remy Descamps pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) fired on target from the rebound. His effort from inside the box was directed low to the middle of the goal.
84' Renan Lodi (Marseille) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
82' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Vitinha (Marseille) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
82' Some neat passing and movement from Marseille as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
79' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Remy Descamps as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
77' Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
75' Chancel Mbemba (Marseille) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Ruddy Buquet saw the whole situation.
74' Pierre Aristouy has decided to substitute Ronael Pierre-Gabriel and he is replaced by Marcus Coco (Nantes).
73' That will be all from Mostafa Mohamed who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Ignatius Ganago (Nantes).
70' Valentin Rongier (Marseille) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
69' Pierre Aristouy is stunned as referee Ruddy Buquet shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
68' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) is coming onto the pitch as Joaquin Correa cannot continue after picking up an injury.

63' Valentin Rongier (Marseille) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards right side of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Remy Descamps pulls off an easy save.
62' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) sends a cross into the box, but Remy Descamps comes off his line to gather the ball.
59' 6:14 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
55' Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle and it's Joaquin Correa (Marseille) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
52' Ronael Pierre-Gabriel (Nantes) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
50' Renan Lodi (Marseille) will deliver the corner kick.
49' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) steps up to send the ball in.
48' Marseille quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
47' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
46' Pierre Aristouy makes a half-time substitution. Kader Bamba (Nantes) comes on in place of Adson.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Joaquin Correa (Marseille) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
45+1' Moses Simon (Nantes) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Renan Lodi (Marseille) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Ruddy Buquet blows for a foul.
43' Joaquin Correa (Marseille) is in acres of space inside the box and lets fly with a shot which goes well wide of the left post. What a poor effort.
43' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
42' A clumsy foul by Adson (Nantes) and Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle.
41' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) heads on.
39' 1 - 1 Goal! Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Moses Simon inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. 1:1.
38' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
37' Some patient build-up play from Marseille as they look to unlock the defence.
34' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
33' Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle for a foul after Quentin Merlin (Nantes) hacks down one of his opponents.
31' Moses Simon (Nantes) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the left post.
29' Chancel Mbemba (Marseille) makes a good run to latch onto the free kick from Jordan Veretout, but pushes his close-range header well past the left post.
26' Ruddy Buquet shows a yellow card to Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) for his blatant foul.
25' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
22' Joaquin Correa (Marseille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
21' Ruddy Buquet couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Douglas Augusto (Nantes) and blew his whistle.
20' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) shows good awareness inside the box, but his attempt is stopped by the goalkeeper.
20' The resulting corner from Moses Simon (Nantes) is cleared.
19' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Renan Lodi (Marseille) but poses no threat.
16' Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Remy Descamps.
13' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
11' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille), who fires in a direct effort inches over the crossbar. What a chance!
9' Bastien Meupiyou (Nantes) cannot believe that he has been told to leave the field of play after the referee blows his whistle and sends him off!
9' Ronael Pierre-Gabriel (Nantes) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
8' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
4' 0 - 1 Goal! Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 0:1.
4' Vitinha (Marseille) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.

3' He should have scored! Vitinha (Marseille) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Remy Descamps makes an easy save.
2' Chancel Mbemba (Marseille) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar.
2' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
